ORDINANCE Sept | qo24

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 22-E in the area bounded by

East 88" Place, a line 121 feet west of and parallel to South
St. Lawrence Avenue; the public alley south of and parallel
To East 88" Place; then a line 152 feet west of and parallel

To South St. Lawrence Avenue

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 545 E. 88" Place, Chicago Illinois
